name: Ditto (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: Ditto (Thailand) Public Company Limited, headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, was established in 2013 and offers a broad spectrum of services. The company's core operations involve providing document management systems to clients across Thailand. Additionally, it engages in the leasing, distribution, and upkeep of various technology products, such as photocopiers and printers. Ditto (Thailand) also delivers specialized technology engineering solutions tailored for numerous government sector projects. Furthermore, their service offerings extend to construction, mechanical and electrical engineering systems, and comprehensive information technology support.
